text: what does ready to move actually mean
bad: /not sure what you'?d like help with|^hi[!,]|welcome to naya|what are you after — area/i
reply: Ready-to-move means construction is complete enough for possession/handover subject to the project's approvals. Under-construction means you book earlier and wait through build stages; possession is tied to the project timeline and phase. For a specific project, ask possession date, phase, and whether it is marked ready-to-move in the catalog. General definitions do not replace the project's stated possession facts.
